note: Диапазоны восстановлены из строк libapp.so оригинального com.tennis.ai v2.0.19 (см. reference/ANALYSIS_FINDINGS.md). proRange:null = диапазон отдаётся из Firestore metric_definitions и из APK восстановлен не был. Поправки — английские шаблоны с плейсхолдером {value}, в тоне оригинальных текстов.

metrics.label: Stance width (feet / shoulders)
metrics.description: Lateral stance width as a ratio of shoulder width. Best players set their feet 0.8–1.5x shoulder width at the stance.

corrections.tooLow: Your stance is too narrow at {value}x shoulder width. Open the feet to 0.8–1.5x shoulder width for a stable base.
corrections.tooHigh: Your stance is too wide at {value}x shoulder width. Narrow it to 0.8–1.5x shoulder width so you can load and drive up.

metrics.label: Front foot angle to baseline
metrics.description: Orientation of the front foot relative to the baseline at the stance.

corrections.tooLow: Your front foot is too parallel to the baseline at {value}°. Angle it 30–45° to the baseline.
corrections.tooHigh: Your front foot is too open at {value}°. Bring it back to 30–45° to the baseline.

metrics.label: Arms position at the split step
metrics.description: Position of the arms during the directional split step.

metrics.label: Knee bend at the unit turn
metrics.description: Knee bend during loading. Deep bend stores elastic energy.

metrics.label: Unit turn (shoulder–hip separation)
metrics.description: Separation angle between the shoulder line and the hip line during the unit turn.

corrections.tooLow: Your unit turn is too small at {value}° of shoulder–hip separation. Coil the shoulders 10–30° past the hips.
corrections.tooHigh: Your unit turn is too big at {value}° of shoulder–hip separation. Stay inside 10–30° to keep the swing repeatable.

metrics.label: Weight transfer
metrics.description: Lateral shift of the body weight into the shot.

metrics.label: Tossing arm extension (elbow)
metrics.description: Elbow extension of the tossing arm during the toss. Best players extend the arm nearly straight.

corrections.tooLow: Your tossing arm is too bent at {value}°. Extend the elbow to 152–180° for a consistent toss.

metrics.label: Toss arm speed
metrics.description: Peak speed of the tossing-arm wrist during the toss.

corrections.tooLow: Your toss is too slow at {value} m/s. Drive the ball up at 1.5–6.0 m/s.
corrections.tooHigh: Your toss is too fast at {value} m/s. Smooth it to 1.5–6.0 m/s for a repeatable placement.

metrics.label: Toes distance to baseline
metrics.description: Distance from the toes to the baseline at the stance. Requires court-line calibration.

corrections.tooLow: Your toes are only {value} cm behind the baseline. Keep 3–15 cm to avoid a foot fault.
corrections.tooHigh: Your toes are {value} cm behind the baseline. Move up to 3–15 cm for a better angle.

metrics.label: Hip extension (ankle–hip–shoulder)
metrics.description: Drive-phase extension through ankle, knee and hip. The ankle–hip–shoulder angle opens to 110–170° in pro serves (Alcaraz 165, Sinner 164, Djokovic 168, Federer 151).

corrections.tooLow: Your hip angle stays closed at {value}°. Extend through the drive to 110–170°.
corrections.tooHigh: Your hip angle opens past {value}°. Keep it inside 110–170° to stay balanced.

metrics.label: Leg extension (heel–hip–shoulder)
metrics.description: Full leg drive measured by the heel–hip–shoulder angle at the loading phase.

corrections.tooLow: Your drive leg is still bent at {value}°. Extend it fully (155–179°) to transfer the ground force.

metrics.label: Knee flexion (hip–knee–ankle)
metrics.description: Knee bend during loading or contact. Deep bend stores elastic energy. Exact pro range is served from Firestore metric_definitions.

metrics.label: Dominant knee flexion
metrics.description: Knee flexion of the dominant leg.

metrics.label: Non-dominant knee flexion
metrics.description: Knee flexion of the non-dominant leg.

metrics.label: Trunk tilt at extension
metrics.description: Trunk tilt from vertical during the serve extension. A second variant (10–45°) appears for groundstrokes.

corrections.tooLow: Your trunk is too vertical at {value}°. Lean into the court 5–39° at extension.
corrections.tooHigh: Your trunk leans too far at {value}°. Bring it back to 5–39° to stay balanced.

metrics.label: Trunk tilt at contact
metrics.description: Trunk tilt from vertical at the groundstroke contact point.

corrections.tooLow: Your trunk is too upright at {value}°. Lean 10–45° into the shot at contact.
corrections.tooHigh: Your trunk leans too far at {value}°. Bring it back to 10–45°.

metrics.label: Shoulder line vs horizontal
metrics.description: Tilt of the shoulder line away from horizontal at the extension phase. Pros keep it under 12°.

corrections.tooHigh: Your shoulders tilt {value}° from horizontal. Keep the shoulder line level (under 12°) at extension.

metrics.label: Racket face vs shoulders
metrics.description: Racket face angle relative to the shoulder line (parallel, vertical) at the trophy position. Requires racket orientation from YOLO detections.

corrections.tooHigh: Your racket face is {value}° off the shoulder line. Keep it parallel (under 25°) and vertical at the trophy.

metrics.label: Trunk rotation displacement
metrics.description: Rotational displacement of the trunk between the unit turn and contact.

corrections.tooLow: Your trunk rotation is too small at {value} cm. Rotate through 3–20 cm to power the shot.
corrections.tooHigh: Your trunk rotation is excessive at {value} cm. Stay inside 3–20 cm for control.

metrics.label: Body alignment at contact
metrics.description: Alignment of the kinetic chain at contact (shoulder–hip–target line). Pairs with M4_CONTACT_ANGLE (60–130°).

corrections.tooLow: Your alignment line breaks at {value}°. Straighten it to 171–189° at contact.

metrics.label: Contact arm angle
metrics.description: Angle of the dominant arm at contact. Pairs with M4_BODY_ALIGNMENT (171–189°): both must hold.

corrections.tooLow: Your contact arm collapses at {value}°. Hold 60–130° at impact.
corrections.tooHigh: Your contact arm is over-extended at {value}°. Keep it at 60–130°.

metrics.label: Wrist speed at contact
metrics.description: Peak speed of the dominant wrist around contact.

corrections.tooLow: Your wrist speed is only {value} m/s. Accelerate through contact to 10–25 m/s.
corrections.tooHigh: Your wrist speed spikes at {value} m/s. Pros sit at 10–25 m/s — smooth the swing.

metrics.label: Toss height / player height
metrics.description: Toss apex height relative to the player height. Pros toss 1.8–2.3x their height.

corrections.tooLow: Your toss peaks at only {value}x your height. Toss to 1.8–2.3x height so you hit at full extension.
corrections.tooHigh: Your toss peaks at {value}x your height. Keep it at 1.8–2.3x — higher tosses drift.

metrics.label: Contact distance from shoulder
metrics.description: Horizontal distance between the contact point and the shoulder line.

corrections.tooLow: You crowd the ball: contact is only {value} cm from the shoulder. Hit 14–72 cm away.
corrections.tooHigh: You reach too far: contact is {value} cm from the shoulder. Bring it to 14–72 cm.

metrics.label: Contact point height
metrics.description: Height of the contact point above the ground.

metrics.label: Racket head position at contact
metrics.description: Position/orientation of the racket head relative to the body at contact.
